about_the_game:
About This Game

Cat of Egypt is a cinematic 2D puzzle-platformer set during the biblical plagues of Egypt.
You play as Pharaoh’s cat — loyal, curious, and suddenly caught in the chaos when the waters turn to blood and frogs overrun the palace.
Guided by ancient hieroglyphs and echoes of divine power, you must uncover the truth behind Pharaoh’s curse and the meaning of “I Am Who I Am.”

Explore a hand-drawn Egyptian world filled with traps, puzzles, and secrets hidden beneath the palace walls. Each plague is a new chapter of discovery, danger, and redemption.

 Features

  • Solve Symbolic Puzzles – Decode hieroglyphs to reveal clues, unlock passages, and awaken long-forgotten magic.

  • Cinematic 2D Exploration – Hand-drawn frames with smooth transitions bring a storybook-like flow to every scene.

  • Dynamic Boss Encounters – Confront each plague’s monstrous guardian in creative battles combining timing and puzzle-solving.

  • Unique Mechanics – Master rope swinging, pole climbing, and paw climbing to explore and survive.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling – Encounter a mysterious talking frog that guides and challenges you through each level.

  • Art & Music – A moody visual style inspired by Neversong and Neva, paired with an original, emotional soundtrack.

 Current Version

The current release includes the first chapter, “The Frog Plague,” featuring:

  • 6 playable frames (scenes)

  • 1 complete boss fight

  • Environmental puzzles and secrets

  • Full controller and keyboard support

Future updates will expand the story through the remaining plagues, culminating in the final revelation of Pharaoh’s cat’s divine journey.
